falsification_conditions.condition: The price of the asset rises above the previous bottom_2024_aug high by 15% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear reversal pattern would invalidate the 'hold' signal by demonstrating a bullish breakout inconsistent with a bear market bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-day average true range (ATR) increases to 200% of the asset's 200-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volatility would contradict the 'hold' signal's implication of market stabilization near the identified pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score exceeds 60 on the final day of the 14-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant increase in panic selling metrics would directly contradict the current 'hold' signal's implication of moderate market stress

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
